name: 400 Series Hardbound Toned Mixed Media Art Journal, Tan, 8.5 x 5.5 in (469-305)
descriptionOriginal: A small hardbound sketchbook of warm tan, toned mixed media paper with a Smyth-sewn binding.
whyWeLikeIt: The page arrives already coloured, so a sparse spread looks deliberate, and the sewn binding lies flatter. Strathmore lists the paper at 300 g/m2 and made for wet and dry media.
limitations: Only 48 pages, so a keen collager will fill it quickly, and heavy layering will still thicken the spine. The tan is a warm, mid tone that will not suit a cool, pale palette.
qualityNote: Customers say they love the colour and the toned paper. Concern: the listing showed no availability line when checked.
specsEvidence: Strathmore, https://strathmoreartist.com/mixed-media/400-series-toned-mixed-media-hardbound-art-journal (read 2026-11-20): 300 g/m2 (184 lb), medium surface, Smyth-sewn binding that allows pages to lay flatter, acid free with 30% post-consumer fibre, 48 pages, 8.5 x 5.5 in in Warm Tan (469-305) and Cool Gray (469-405), matte dark brown cover, suited to graphite, coloured pencil, markers, acrylic, watercolour, gouache, pen and ink, charcoal and gel pens. Retailers disagree on page count (48 versus 128 for a different sketch edition); we use the maker's 48.
suitability: A small, toned, sewn-bound heavy-paper book for layering collage and adhesive in a first junk journal.
